• È tutto o niente per IP. La spunta div: • It is all or nothing per IP. The tick splits every machine of that IP, you cannot split off just one. To keep two out of three together, give those two the same name: they become one group (for example “Interni” joins two and the third stays apart). But their measurements mix again, which was the original problem, so it only makes sense if they really are the same thing. • Machines are recognised by the machine name (hostname). If you cloned containers and they all have the same name, the panel cannot tell them apart and sees them as one machine. In that case just give the machines different names from the system. • The name is read by the nightly diagnostics: a site never diagnosed stays alone on the IP until it arrives.
